We evaluate the models on Alpaca Eval 2 and MT-bench. Alpaca Eval 2 is an automated metric that measures LLMs' alignment with human preferences using 805 representative instructions. For each instruction, the evaluated model's response and gpt-4-turbo's response are compared head-to-head using an auto-evaluator.
